## Outcome and ownership

State client outcome, accountable person, reviewer, available capacity and target working day. Do not guess GitHub handles.

## Scope and dependencies

List approved scope, dependencies and applicable G01–G12 gates. Work does not confer live launch permission.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Outcome demonstrated with real permitted evidence where required.
- [ ] Failure, replay, suppression and privacy effects tested.
- [ ] Restricted approval references current; no sensitive data in GitHub.
- [ ] Known gaps, costs and capacity disclosed.
- [ ] Documentation/runbook updated; no unapproved activation, transfer, spend or billing.

## Stop conditions

State exclusions and when escalation or a signed scope change is required.
